designationHistory.name: Saint Croix Island National Monument
designationHistory.indexText: Congress authorized Saint Croix Island National Monument in Maine, to be established once enough of the island was in federal hands.

authority.citation: Act of June 8, 1949, ch. 180 (Public Law 81-87), 63 Stat. 158

designationHistory.note: The Secretary's order establishing the monument was to be published in the Federal Register; it was not located. A local dedication of the monument took place June 30, 1968 (NPS History Collection).

sources.name: NPS, The National Parks: Index 2012-2016 (Maine), 'Authorized as a national monument June 8, 1949'

designationHistory.indexText: Congress redesignated Saint Croix Island National Monument as Saint Croix Island International Historic Site, noting the site's importance to both Canada and the United States.

sources.name: NPS, The National Parks: Index 2012-2016 (Maine), 'redesignated an international historic site Sept. 25, 1984'
